user_problem: Analysts need deterministic cohort assignment from supplied inclusion, exclusion, precedence, and date rules.
unique_output: A rule table plus synthetic classifications showing included, excluded, overlapping, and indeterminate cases.
required_input: Cohort definitions, fields, date boundaries, exclusion rules, precedence, and missing-value behavior.
critical_rule: Do not assign a record when required inputs are missing or overlapping rules lack stated precedence.
nearest_existing_and_difference: Nearest is metric-definition-card; this operationalizes cohort membership rather than documenting a metric population and denominator.
acceptance_scenario: Input cohort New requires signup in January 2026; exclude staff; missing staff status is indeterminate. Records are Jan 5 nonstaff, Jan 8 staff, Jan 9 unknown. Output: included, excluded, indeterminate.
